findings.text: The status file still says "Owner clarification is pending", but the new line 55 records that the owner decided on 2026-11-20 to require pairwise uniqueness of new keys, so the document contradicts itself. Fix: Mark lines 38-39 as superseded by the 2026-11-20 decision, or replace them with a short note that points to it.

The status file says the validity bridge is "pending the premise for keys within a batch", but the premise was approved on 2026-11-20 (line 55), so only the bridge's implementation is still open. Fix: Say that the premise is agreed and that the bridge still has to be built against it.
